items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I was studying with Georges Muller on bass... and Roland Nadeau on piano.

ctx.x: The New England Conservatory, you went there and you played bass and piano?

The first year I was a piano major and a bass minor, and I was studying with Georges Muller on bass, who was the first bassist with the Boston Symphony, and Roland Nadeau on piano. I had taught myself how to read bass music and how to play the instrument because in junior high school there were eight pianists that wanted to play and the band director said, “How would you like to play one of those?” And I said, “Fine.” So I became a bass player. And I did that for ten years including amateur symphony work. So it…
Yeah I want to talk about that but down the line just a little bit. You played, your studies in the conservatory were mostly of a classical nature?
